straight.description: The robot should move straight forward 0.45 m along the +x direction and the stop. The final orientation should remain at 0 radians because the robot shouldn't make any turns.

turn_then_drive.description: The robot will first rotate 90 degrees to the left. It will then move forward 0.30 m in the +y direction and stop. Its final position will be at (0, 0.30), facing 1.57 radians from its starting direction

arc.description: The robot will follow a curved path to the left, traveling 0.60 m while turning about 92 degrees. Its final heading will be about 1.60 radians.
